resolution.lessonBodies: All 102 lesson bodies are served by sing, ported from GuitarHub's voice-instruction.json (#47).
resolution.identity: Not migrated. Every lesson on sing is readable without an account, so no identity mapping is needed to reach one.
resolution.entitlements: Resolved by the 2026-09-23 decision: every stage is free on sing, so no GuitarHub lifetime purchaser loses access.
resolution.progress: Not imported. GuitarHub's lesson attempts stay in GuitarHub. sing shows practice counts derived from its own room sessions and records no lesson completion.
resolution.urlParity: Every GuitarHub lesson URL has a sing destination in contracts/suede-voice-lesson-urls.json.
resolution.vocalReview: Open. Qualified vocal-pedagogy and clinical-safety review of the advanced belt, weight, range-extension and effects lessons has not happened.
resolution.deviceAudio: Open. Physical-microphone checks from GuitarHub's audio release checklist have not been run.
